en: "Anyway, now that I know we're after{n} the same rings of the Twelve Gods,{n} I can't just let you walk away."
"So you do mean to fight after all?"
"Once two ring holders have met,{n} a fight is a fate that{n} can't be avoided..."
"It's a pity, but it can't be helped.{n} I made my peace with that when{n} I set foot on this island..."
"However many I have to cut down,{n} I will obtain the Almighty Treasure{n} and seal it away forever..."
"That's just pretty talk in the end.{n} Once you have the Almighty Treasure,{n} even you will change your mind."
"No human in this world gets hold{n} of enormous power and then{n} doesn't try to use it..."
"Power has different names, but it's{n} all the same. Everyone chases it and{n} spends their life hurting others."
"As long as I'm all right, who cares."
"I think I understand, somehow.{n} You've seen more than enough{n} of people like that, haven't you?"
"But are humans really such foolish{n} creatures, nothing but desire,{n} smeared in other people's blood?"
"Almighty Treasure or whatever it is,{n} they're still locked in a bloodbath{n} over something nobody understands."
"This island is the world in miniature."
"A small world afloat in Avalon,{n} where foolish, unsightly humans{n} bare their true nature."
"That may well be so. But we're human{n} too. That's exactly why I want{n} to keep believing in humans."
"Even as they repeat pointless wars,{n} humans alone in this world know{n} how to be kind to others."
"They look after the weak, share{n} their joys, and live by supporting{n} each other. They have that wisdom."
"Such humans can, by their own will,{n} cast away even war itself.{n} I believe that with all my heart."
"I mean, isn't it? Huh? In the end,{n} all we can do in this place{n} is cross swords."
"When two sides want the same thing{n} for different ends, in the end{n} they can only fight each other."
"That's exactly why I want to seal{n} the Almighty Treasure, the seed{n} of all this strife!"
"Humans have found out about it.{n} There's no going back, ever again."
"Even if we can't go back, we can{n} stand our ground where we are!"
"Even as we talk, other countries'{n} armies are pushing deeper into{n} the island. I can't waste time."
"So that even if my hands are{n} stained with blood, our children{n} can stay clean."
"Look at a newborn baby. Humans,{n} like every other living thing,{n} are born covered in blood."
"And they lament, grieve and dread{n} having been born into this world,{n} and bawl with bright red faces."
"You've regretted being born into{n} this world all this time,{n} haven't you?"
"I'm sorry, Lady {name:6}!{n} I never thought it would{n} come to this!"
"You're an army chaplain, aren't you?{n} The ones you should worry about now{n} aren't me. They're your comrades!"
"No one can do two things at once.{n} If you can't save both friend and{n} foe, then at least save your friends."
"Yup! Tons and tons of fun!{n} 'Cause I finally found a prince{n} who's all my own!"
"My cursed, uncanny power serves to{n} protect the one who saved me.{n} Nothing could gladden me more."
"I am {name:6} of the Isle of{n} Ifish, of the Holy Knight bloodline."
"Remember it. My name is {hero:6}.{n} I'm of the Dark Knight bloodline."
"I made sure to miss your vitals.{n} Now get out of here, fast."
"A sacred knight... a Holy Knight, huh."
"That bunch looks like a far tougher{n} opponent than your average army."
{n} will be in our care from now on."
"Please leave this place quickly.{n} I made sure to miss your vitals."
"I don't want to take lives needlessly."
"It makes me want to puke...{n} {w:1}that... {w:1}softness of yours..."
"But... {w:1}next time we meet...{n} it won't... {w:1}go so well for you..."
"For now... {w:1}all we can do is{w:1} regroup...{n} I hate to lose time, but... {w:1}for a bit...{n} {w:1}let's rest up..."
"Isn't that Ayame!?{n} Hey, that's you over there,{n} isn't it, Ayame?"
"Is she a friend of yooours,{n} Ayame dear?"
"Alice and I are both Esper Dolls,{n} of the Rhodes army's{n} Esper Girl Corps."
"I thought all my friends in the{n} Esper Girl Corps had died!"
"It is the same for me. To meet again{n} alive... nothing could gladden me{n} more. Truly, I am glad you are safe."
"Oho!? A tearful reunion of two{n} lovely girls! Beautiful! Too{n} beautiful! I'm moved something fierce!"
"Tch! Damn Esper Dolls! They're{n} the reason the order came down{n} for us Rhodes troops to retreat!"
"Don't get heated, Parsifal.{n} Keep your hands off for now.{n} We watch a little longer."
"Hey! Hey! Hey!{n} Never mind that, Ayame, you{n} come along with me too! Okay!?"

"Why why why why why why whyyy!?{n} Ayame, could it be...{n} you hate Alice now?"
"But this old lady here,{n} {name:6}, saved my life and{n} blessed me with peace of heart."
"No... I mean... Ayame dear... like{n} I keep telling you... it's...{n} 'young lady'... if you pleeease."
"Therefore I cannot go with you, Alice."
"Will you not come with me instead?{n} {name:6} is a great fool, but as{n} truly kind as a holy mother."
"Ever since I met {name:6},{n} I have felt a deep peace of heart{n} such as I had never known."
"No no no no no no no!{n} I can't do that!{n} Leave Prince {hero:6}!?"

"It will mean we fight.{n} You accept that?"
"It can't be helped.{n} It just can't be helped, right?"
"Each for the one she believes in."
"But if it's you, Ayame, it's okay!{n} Even if I get killed or torn to{n} pieces, I'll forgive you!"
"In the end, even old friends wind{n} up fighting. That's the law of{n} this island of steel."
"Hey, Aerial. You do remember our{n} promise from the other day, right?"
"Next time we met that woman, you'd{n} get your hands dirty too."
"That's what I told you, isn't it?"
"That's all right, Aerial.{n} Please, don't you worry{n} about meee."
"You went to war as an army chaplain!{n} Why are you with people like thaaat!?"
"But please, believe me! You were so{n} good to me, Lady {name:6}. I am{n} by no means betraying you!"
"To cure the sickness of evil eating{n} away at Mr. {hero:6}'s heart,{n} I am continuing my journey!"
"That is my duty as a priest!"
"So that's how it was, Aerial.{n} It's all right. I believe there's{n} no lie in what you saaay."
"But at this rate, I will end up{n} fighting you, Lady {name:6}..."

"Tch, what a pain of a woman, I swear.{n} God this, lost lamb that...{n} Lines like that make me want to puke!"
"That is because your heart is{n} afflicted by the sickness of evil."
"Where there is no love in the heart,{n} even the most beautiful words{n} cannot stir a person's breast..."

"So that's how it is, old lady!"
"I'm terribly sorry, but this time{n} I'll be taking haaalf your money."
"I'll use it with caaare.{n} So please forgive me, okaaay..."
"This time, instead of a ring,{n} I'm taking half your cash."
